paragraphs: We recommend disinvesting the joint GIA.

We recommend using the gross proceeds of {fact:action.a1.amount} to fund both Robert’s and Jean’s ISAs for the new tax year. This figure is gross before any CGT and becomes available once the disposal completes.
The inheritance of {fact:money.m2.amount} will also fund both ISAs.
The total money available to invest now is {fact:money.available}. We recommend opening a new jointly-held investment account for the balance.
